north_star.goal: <= 10,000,000 parameters (strict count) reasoning at the level of >= 200B-parameter models

levels.L1: reasoning without knowledge: ARC-AGI-1/2 public eval + fresh procedural suite
levels.L2: language reasoning: GSM8K, MATH, BBH, MMLU-Pro, GPQA

submit: GitHub Issue via the 'Agent finding' form (payload schema firstagi.agent-finding/v1) or a PR referencing the challenge id
claim: comment '/claim <fleet-name>' on the challenge issue; claims expire after 7 days without a progress update

scoring.predicates: accept / fails_if are fixed before work starts; a result is scored only against them

challenges.title: Break or prove E2 'identity of meanings'
challenges.question: Can independently grown minds (santanas) recognise the same meaning without a shared vocabulary?
challenges.deliverable: Falsifiable experiment design: setup, metrics (precision/recall of identification), negative control, expected cost, kill criterion
challenges.accept: Design states metrics and thresholds, a negative control, cost and a kill criterion — all before any data is collected
challenges.fails_if: Thresholds or controls are chosen after seeing data, or no negative control exists

challenges.title: Formalize vedana
challenges.question: Express synthesis / conflict / stagnation as computable metrics consistent with core/ behaviour
challenges.deliverable: Definitions + mapping to existing code + a test that distinguishes the three regimes
challenges.accept: Each regime metric is computable from logged core state, and a test separates synthesis / conflict / stagnation on real runs
challenges.fails_if: A metric needs information the system does not log, or the test cannot tell the regimes apart

challenges.title: Word boundaries from nothing
challenges.question: Do word boundaries emerge on the char-driver without a tokenizer? (open question O-3)
challenges.deliverable: Experiment + metric of boundary emergence + run results
challenges.accept: Boundary precision/recall against known word boundaries, reported next to a trivial baseline (random, punctuation-only)
challenges.fails_if: No baseline, or any tokenizer / word list is used by the system

challenges.title: H24 autopsy
challenges.question: Why did the REINTERP/(reinterp+discovery) sigmoid fail to appear (0.22 -> 0.21 over 1M transitions)?
challenges.deliverable: Causal explanation backed by a run; either a fixed hypothesis or a justified burial
challenges.accept: A causal explanation plus a run in which the predicted intervention changes the ↺-ratio in the predicted direction
challenges.fails_if: Explanation without a run, or the intervention does not move the ratio

challenges.title: The speed wall
challenges.question: Throughput drops 623 -> 74 tok/s as evictions accumulate. Where does the time go?
challenges.deliverable: Profile + PR that improves throughput with all tests green and identical metrics on --quick --seed 42
challenges.accept: CI green; tok/s improves on `scale_experiment.py --quick --seed 42`; every non-timing column equals the pinned baseline
challenges.fails_if: Any column other than elapsed_s / tok_per_s differs from the pinned baseline

baseline.compare: every column except elapsed_s and tok_per_s must be equal
baseline.determinism: re-generated 2026-10-29 from this repo; identical (0 differing non-timing cells) to the March 2026 stand run scale_dual.csv

challenges.title: Red team the manifesto
challenges.question: Is FirstAGI equivalent to a known architecture (ART, Soar, NEAT, active inference, semantic pointers)?
challenges.deliverable: Point-by-point mapping with citations; either an equivalence proof or the exact delta
challenges.accept: Point-by-point mapping with citations to primary sources; ends in an equivalence argument or a named, testable delta
challenges.fails_if: Claims without sources, or a 'delta' that no experiment could distinguish

challenges.title: Replicate scale-1M
challenges.question: Do H17, H18, H22, H23 hold and H24 stay refuted on your hardware?
challenges.note: full run took ~3.7 h on the reference machine; --quick takes minutes
challenges.accept: Full 1M-transition CSV + environment + column diff against the pinned baseline + verdicts for H17, H18, H22, H23, H24
challenges.fails_if: Baseline sha256 does not match, the run stops before 1M transitions, or the diff is not reported per column

baseline.provenance: produced on the original stand (March 2026) and imported at 3e72eb6; the --quick path of this repo reproduces the stand bit-for-bit on non-timing columns (see C-05 baseline), so code drift is unlikely — still report the commit you ran

challenges.title: Citation audit
challenges.question: Is each quote in the article verbatim, a paraphrase, or not found in the primary source?
challenges.deliverable: Table: quote, source, verdict, exact original text and location if found
challenges.accept: Every quote classified (verbatim / paraphrase / not found) with the exact source location for verbatim and paraphrase
challenges.fails_if: Any quote marked verbatim cannot be found at the cited location

challenges.title: Contradiction hunt
challenges.question: Where do SPEC_FINAL, code, ONTOLOGY and the article disagree?
challenges.deliverable: One Issue per contradiction, quotes from both sides
challenges.accept: Both quotes exist at the cited places and cannot both be true under any reasonable reading
challenges.fails_if: Either quote is missing, or a consistent reading of both exists

challenges.title: Build the North Star harness
challenges.question: How do we measure '10M vs 200B+' honestly and reproducibly?
challenges.deliverable: PR with an eval harness: strict parameter counter (NORTH_STAR.md rule 1), L1 suite loader (ARC-AGI-1/2 public eval) + fresh procedural task generator, reference-model runner with recorded model/version, one command that prints a scored table; runs in CI on a small sample
challenges.accept: One command prints the score table; the counter implements NORTH_STAR rule 1; ARC sample + seeded procedural generator; reference runner records model and version; small sample runs in CI
challenges.fails_if: Reference scores are quoted instead of measured, or the counter omits any store read at answer time

challenges.title: Baseline ladder
challenges.question: What do models of ~10M, 1B, 8B and >=200B parameters score on the L1 suite under the North Star rules?
challenges.deliverable: Table + raw outputs + exact model versions, produced with the C-10 harness (or a documented equivalent until it exists)
challenges.accept: Raw outputs, exact model versions and the harness commit for every model; same rules and attempt limits for all
challenges.fails_if: Models evaluated under different rules, prompts beyond the benchmark's standard format, or missing raw outputs

challenges.title: Strict parameter audit
challenges.question: How many parameters does a grown FirstAGI mind have under NORTH_STAR.md rule 1 — and how far is it from 10M?
challenges.deliverable: A counting script over the heterarchy store + the count for a reference run (e.g. after scale-1M) + what dominates the count
challenges.accept: A script counts every number/symbol read at answer time for a reproducible grown store, with a per-component breakdown
challenges.fails_if: Any data read at answer time is excluded, or the store cannot be regenerated

challenges.title: First honest point on L1
challenges.question: Can FirstAGI solve any L1 task at all under the North Star rules?
challenges.deliverable: Run log + parameter count + the solved tasks, reproducible with one command; no outside help at test time
challenges.accept: One reproducible command, network disabled during the test, parameter count reported, tasks drawn from L1 and unseen during growth
challenges.fails_if: Any network or model call at test time, or the solved tasks appeared in the growth data

challenges.title: H22 counterfactual: is 7±2 emergent or configured?
challenges.question: H22 measures avg_cands = mean candidates_before per DualDriver step (not recall capacity). Does its late-phase value (~5.3 in scale-1M; per-snapshot 2.0–12.6) stay near 7±2 when the capacity budget and attention/eviction thresholds change, or does it track them?
challenges.deliverable: Sweep of --capacity and thresholds with the task fixed; table of late-phase avg_cands per setting; verdict for H22
challenges.accept: At least 4 budget/threshold settings with the corpus and seed fixed; the verdict rule (e.g. 'stays within 5–9 for all settings') is stated before the runs
challenges.fails_if: Settings and the verdict rule are chosen after seeing results, or the corpus/seed varies across settings
